newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.623 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.623 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended April 5 was 4,623,906 gallons compared to 5,061,642 gallons last week.
Imports were 293,098 gallons against 349,555 gallons the previous week. There were 146,144 domestic receipts for this week compared to 13,448 the previous week.
Retail movement was 825,498 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,289,476 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 95,744,624 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 175,995,014 gallons.
